milestone: Adaptive MultiQuery RAG / Unseen Generalization Hardening
base_runtime: verified v6.4.94 Operational Hardening / Portable KB

fixes.multi_query_rag: Adaptive MultiQuery is enabled for semantic retrieval only after exact structured and BM25 fast paths. The original query plus up to two safe alternatives are fused with reciprocal-rank fusion before the existing hybrid ranking and BGE reranker.
fixes.multi_query_precision_guard: The existing BGE reranker, Final Top-K 3, and 0.55 confidence threshold remain unchanged; variants may not invent structured identifiers.
fixes.multi_query_ab_toggle: DOCUBOT_MULTI_QUERY=0 disables MultiQuery for baseline/A-B comparison without source edits.
fixes.followup_isolation: Standalone why/what-rule/Tagalog technical questions no longer inherit prior grounded context unless the current turn contains an explicit deictic reference.
fixes.operator_preservation: C logical operators && and || are preserved as semantic retrieval terms during normalization.
fixes.permission_intent: Generic allowed/permitted questions route to Yes/No rather than AUTHORIZED ENTITY; entity authorization remains limited to who/which-entity wording.
fixes.structured_topic_specificity: Natural topic queries prefer Rule statements that satisfy the user's extra topic terms before expanding an entire Section family.
fixes.permission_absence: Text-only questions about omitting an explicitly required construct can return a grounded No when the source requires that construct to be present.
fixes.near_threshold_structured_rescue: A directly matching authoritative Rule/Directive requirement just below 0.55 can be rescued within a narrow margin when lexical/MultiQuery evidence is strong; the global threshold itself is not lowered.
